candidate.dashboard: 127.0.0.1-only Python dashboard; bootstrap.html is transient and closes after handshake

architecture.parallelism: one serial worker per primary platform; maximum three concurrently
architecture.browser_targets: one owned ordinary Chrome Default-profile window and one reused search tab per active platform
architecture.detail_acquisition: cards first, bounded embedded search-pane selection, proven identity, substantive detail, durable provenance
architecture.controls: durable replay-safe control_requests with run/platform/action identity and acknowledgement
architecture.cache: optional separate safe crawl_observations SQLite store; cache failure falls back to fresh crawling
architecture.ledger: authoritative jobs.sqlite3, source occurrences, versions, diffs, funnel/application history and checkpoints preserved
architecture.rec_102: supersession candidate: the new pane-first one-search-tab architecture replaces historical reusable-detail-tab routine

deterministic_verification.isolation: tests and validation use disposable databases; no unattended validation points at production jobs.sqlite3

instrumentation.current_main_baseline: explicit semantic model of one standalone detail navigation per claimed detail work item; not a second live crawl

ui_evidence.render_mechanism: repository Playwright headless render against disposable fixture dashboard
not_claimed: CUA screenshot capture; browser surface was unavailable

safety_invariants: challenge/sign-in/error/interstitial states fail closed and preserve checkpoint
no cookies, credentials, tokens, CAPTCHA material, or Chrome profile data in observation cache
cache is never canonical application/funnel truth
